label: Normal (yellow to brown)
guidance: Mustard yellow through tan or brown — the usual range on breastmilk or formula.

label: Green
guidance: Still normal. Often a fast trip through the gut, a cold, or iron in formula.

label: Black
guidance: Meconium is black and expected in the first week. Black stool after that can be old blood — call your pediatrician.

label: Red
guidance: Red streaks or blood in the stool should be looked at by your pediatrician.

label: White
guidance: Chalky white stool can mean bile is not reaching the gut — call your pediatrician.

label: Light gray
guidance: Pale gray stool can mean bile is not reaching the gut — call your pediatrician.
